values.value: Special-category data (GDPR Article 9) needs extra protection, and an agent must never use it by accident. Set the Data Sensitivity Level (and Compliance Categorization) on each field listed, confirm with your DPO whether you need it at all, and keep these fields out of agent scope unless a DPIA approves it. Data on children needs particular care.
Every field that looks like special-category data has a data sensitivity level, or no such fields exist.

Looks for fields that seem to hold special-category or vulnerable-person data (health, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, vulnerability or safeguarding, minors, criminal records) on donor objects and custom objects, and checks whether they have a data sensitivity level. Also counts Contacts under 18. It reads field names and labels only, so sensitive details typed into notes or descriptions aren't found.
GDPR Article 9 - Special categories of personal data|https://gdpr-info.eu/art-9-gdpr/
